title: Zainab e moula raza masooma
body:
Ya Fatima, Ya Tahera
Ya Khwahar e Maula Raza
Ya Sayyada, Ya Shafe'a
Ya Binte Rasul e Khuda
Ya Aalimah, Ya Zahida, Ya Saleha ukht ur-Raza
Tasveer e Rukh e Fatima
Masooma, Masooma
Dukhtar e Sher e Khuda, Masooma
Zainab e Maula Raza, Masooma
1) Tere khuddaam mujhe jaante hein
He ye ayzaaz mera, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Jis ko kehta he Khuda Baab e Murad
Aap hein uss ki dua, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Aaj bhi baant ta he Bayt e Noor
Chaand, suraj ko ziyaa, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Mukhtasir Nad e Ali he ye bhi
Dekh keh kar zara Ya Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Choom ne aati he Bibi Maryam
Aap ke sar ki rida, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Us ne Mashhad se dua li jis ne
Naam beti ka rakha, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Baad me Zahra likha he me ne
Pehle kaaghaz pe likha, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Saray Masoomo'n Nay Aey Shahzadi
Tum Ko Masooma Kahan, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Pass Parday Ka Jin Behno Ko
Un Ko Deti Hai Dua, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
10) Baap Bhi Bhai Bhatija Bhi Wali
Hain Wilayat Ka Pata, Masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
11) Kuch Nahi Kuch Bhi Nahi Mir Hasan
Tairay Khadim Kay Siwa, Masooma
author: Mir Hassan Mir
